The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

Cardamom builds data modernization, EHR integration and analytics environments for over 150 healthcare organizations, each client bringing its own EHR and data warehouse systems into the engagement.

Even where each client's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same clinical and data record.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what a health IT consulting firm Cardamom's size spends on technology.
